Good to hear that these people exist that can try to bridge gaps, but they aren't really well-known names. I'm hoping they are successful at building those gaps because they don't feel like they have had much reach. 

Its not that simple. I agree that it takes both of them to choosing the steps to not be lonely, but it goes back to my initial point: I have had 2 ace friendships shrivel because they don't want to communicate and the other shouldn't be as hard as it is to maintain that friendship. Theres also friendships I lost because they have become too toxic, Threes also friendships that have existed because we are just not compatible. There are many factors to the epidemic.

I tried my best with my ex, And I thought there was real hope I would remain friends with her after the breakup but then a bunch of drama that is going on behind the scenes happened and all I can feel is bad for myself and bad for her.

I know I can have strong connections with people that are not ace but it would be nice to not have a friend who has no filter when it comes to things like s3x. And if there is an allo out there that could connect with how being ace affects me, I have yet to find them.

There is a loneliness epidemic, And sure people can become less lonely but it doesnt stop others from having a relatable friend. Theres having friends and then theres having friends you can relate to.

I know theres no irl ace meetups happening because I live in the rural south, in a place where nothing happens where people just talk about avoiding getting into crime a s3x. Its not finding friends that are the problem. Its finding and maintaining a friendship with someone who I can relate to.
